subject: scaling data annotation workflows
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congratulations on the shared services launch with ADASTEC and Karsan. I
thought now is a good time to connect since we are working with companies
in the AV/ADAS space like Woven by Toyota, Nexar, and Motive, which work
with models that are trained from vehicle-mounted camera data.

We take care of improving training data quality and scale annotation
pipelines, so AI teams can focus on boosting model accuracy and speed to
market. Quick context: Encord is a data layer scale-up, helping over 200+
AI teams across industries - we're especially well versed in VLM use cases
like AV/ADAS, construction, and robotics.

How do you approach data annotation workflows at beep? I am available
Mon/Tues to chat.

subject: Congrats on your new role!
text:
Hi [NAME],

I'd like to connect since we work with Motive, whom similar to [COMPANY]
develops AI dash cam using road-facing and in-cab videos. I'm keen to get
your fresh perspective on how your team approaches annotation quality and
whether you're encountering similar challenges.

For Motive, video annotation efficiency across billion miles of driving
data has been a major focus. They've seen meaningful improvements after
moving to Encord, especially in identifying long-tail events and
autolabeling at scale, which helped eliminate repetitive, frame-by-frame
work.

Also [SENDER] says hello - think you two crossed path back in the
days. He's been closely working with our customer Woven (Toyota) - which
you might find interesting given your experience in self-driving cars.

Would next Tuesday morning work for a 30-min conversation?

subject: Evaluate Encord?
text:
Hi [NAME],

As Labelbox has shifted more toward BPO services and less toward core
platform development, we've seen a number of teams move over to Encord for
stronger data curation, annotation, and model-eval workflows.

We've continued to invest heavily in the software platform most recently
releasing [SENDER] 3 inside Encord. For See & Spray type workloads, [SENDER] 3 can
dramatically accelerate pre-labeling for plants, weeds, soil, and shadows,
producing cleaner segmentation masks with far less manual work.

Better masks creates more reliable spray decisions in production,
especially for early-growth weeds where accuracy matters most.

Would you be open to connecting briefly next week to share a quick overview
and see if it's relevant ahead of your renewal?
-[SENDER]

Hi [NAME], 

Our founder [SENDER] is hosting a small dinner for Heads of ML/ computer vision in San [SENDER] on Tuesday (12/2) in conjunction with NeurIPS. We'd love to see you there! 

We've reserved a private room at Herb & Wood from 6:30pm, with guests joining from Woven (Toyota), Skydio, Zipline and more. We're capping the attendance at 20 to ensure engaging discussions. 

For context: Encord helps 200+ AI teams improve data quality at scale. We unify curation, model-assisted annotations and human review in one platform, with the goals of accelerating training dataset preparation. 

Would you be interested in joining us on the 2nd?
